description: arXiv:2510.04802v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Observing surgical practice has historically relied on fixed vantage points or recollections, leaving the egocentric perspectives that shape clinical decisions undocumented. Ambient fixed cameras capture the operating room (OR) at room scale but cannot recover what any individual team member actually saw. We present EgoSurg, a framework...
